character.locked_description: Maya is a 9-year-old South Asian girl with a compact build, warm brown skin, and a round face. Her dark curly hair is tied high in a neat bun. She wears a teal windbreaker in #2A9D8F, black fingerless gloves, dark trousers, and sturdy sneakers. A small adjustable wrench hangs from a lanyard around her neck. At rest, she sits upright and balanced in a sleek, lightweight manual wheelchair. The wheelchair features bright orange spoke guards in #F4A261 and a custom toolkit securely strapped under the seat, functioning as an integrated extension of her daily attire.
